column1: # The frozen families held to a contract re-taken on the laptop (Sprint 378; the Decision "Which Windows w2m answers as, the reference being the laptop", 2026-11-27): family, contract@version (the same contract its family record names, at the version whose rows the laptop run gives), the laptop run those rows come from (a run under store/probe-runs/ whose profile.txt begins "laptop-"); read by crates/w2m_vm/src/bin/family_known.rs, which prints every run of a family named here with this contract in place of its record's COMPARISON_COMPLETED's, and its row rule from this contract, into store/family_runs/known-2026-10-29.tsv. A family the frozen index lacks, a contract file that does not exist, another contract than the record's, a run that is not a stored laptop run, or a family named twice is refused by name. Empty of families until a card re-takes a family's contract: 379 version, 380 system_info and files_more.
